correctness.rationale: All 16,383 nonempty vertex subsets are exhaustively tested. The 2,256 valid faces, 1,121 cover matchings, and all 10,150 Hasse incidences are independently regenerated and acyclicity checked by complete directed topological sort. Exactly a point and thirteen 5-cells remain, forcing the integral 13-sphere wedge. The complete 336-element incidence-graph automorphism group is independently generated via all 7! point permutations and a polarity, and the Lefschetz trace agrees with the 14-point augmentation character for every element. Rational quotient homology uses exact invariants under finite group actions; mod-two boundary ranks independently agree.

value.rationale: The Heawood graph is the canonical 14-vertex cubic girth-six cage and the incidence graph of the Fano plane. Its Ind_2 complex is a natural missing topology benchmark between known ordinary graph-independence constructions and broader higher-independence families. The full 336-element augmentation-character identification explains the thirteen-dimensional top homology equivariantly and determines contrasting rational orbit-space homology for full versus point/line-preserving symmetry; this is not determined by a homology rank or textbook family substitution.
